title: Order Placement and Checkout Flow
activity_flow: START
OrderServlet: get HttpSession → read 'username' and 'password' attributes
[GUARD] if username == null OR password == null → sendRedirect('login.jsp?message=Session Expired')
OrderServlet: parse paidAmount = Double.parseDouble(request.getParameter('amount'))
OrderServlet: call new OrderServiceImpl().paymentSuccess(userName, paidAmount)
OrderServiceImpl.paymentSuccess: status = 'Order Placement Failed!'
OrderServiceImpl: cartItems = CartServiceImpl().getAllCartItems(userName) → SELECT from cart DB
[GUARD] if cartItems.size() == 0 → return 'Order Placement Failed!'
OrderServiceImpl: create TransactionBean(userName, paidAmount) → IDUtil.generateTransId() → 'T' + yyyyMMddhhmmss, Timestamp = System.currentTimeMillis()
OrderServiceImpl: transactionId = transaction.getTransactionId()
LOOP: for each CartBean item in cartItems
OrderServiceImpl: amount = ProductServiceImpl().getProductPrice(item.getProdId()) * item.getQuantity()
OrderServiceImpl: create OrderBean(transactionId, prodId, quantity, amount)
OrderServiceImpl: ordered = addOrder(order) → INSERT INTO orders(transid, prodid, quantity, amount, shipped=0)
[GUARD] if addOrder fails → break loop (ordered=false)
OrderServiceImpl: ordered = CartServiceImpl().removeAProduct(userId, prodId) → DELETE from cart
[GUARD] if removeAProduct fails → break loop (ordered=false)
OrderServiceImpl: ordered = ProductServiceImpl().sellNProduct(prodId, quantity) → UPDATE product stock
[GUARD] if sellNProduct fails → break loop (ordered=false)
END LOOP
[GUARD] if ordered == false → return 'Order Placement Failed!'
OrderServiceImpl: ordered = new OrderServiceImpl().addTransaction(transaction) → INSERT INTO transactions(transid, username, time, amount)
[GUARD] if addTransaction fails → return 'Order Placement Failed!'
OrderServiceImpl: fetch user first name via UserServiceImpl().getFName(userName)
OrderServiceImpl: MailMessage.transactionSuccess(userName, firstName, transId, transAmount)
MailMessage: build HTML email body with transId and transAmount
MailMessage: JavaMailUtil.sendMail(recipient, subject, htmlBody) via Jakarta Mail
OrderServiceImpl: status = 'Order Placed Successfully!'
OrderServiceImpl: return status
OrderServlet: get PrintWriter, setContentType('text/html')
OrderServlet: RequestDispatcher.include(request, response) → forward to orderDetails.jsp
OrderServlet: pw.println script injecting status into #message element
END
key_decisions: Session check: missing username/password → redirect to login (no order processing)
Empty cart check: no cart items → early return with failure status
Per-item addOrder failure → break loop, skip transaction commit
Per-item removeAProduct failure → break loop, skip transaction commit
Per-item sellNProduct failure → break loop, skip transaction commit
addTransaction failure → no email sent, failure status returned
addTransaction success → email confirmation sent, success status returned
key_relationships: OrderServiceImpl depends_on TransactionBean (creates instance, calls addTransaction)
OrderServiceImpl depends_on DBUtil (provideConnection in addOrder, addTransaction)
MailMessage depends_on JavaMailUtil (sendMail static call via Jakarta Mail)
important_notes: No DB transaction/rollback: if loop breaks mid-way, earlier order rows are NOT rolled back — partial inserts possible
addTransaction called on 'new OrderServiceImpl()' (fresh instance), not 'this'
TransactionBean auto-generates ID in constructor: 'T' + yyyyMMddhhmmss via IDUtil.generateTransId()
IDUtil also provides generateId() for product IDs ('P' + yyyyMMddhhmmss)
MailMessage.transactionSuccess() always fires after addTransaction succeeds, even if mail fails (exception swallowed)
OrderServlet uses RequestDispatcher.include() not forward() — response stays writable after JSP inclusion
db_operations: addOrder: INSERT INTO orders(transid, prodid, quantity, amount, shipped=0)
addTransaction: INSERT INTO transactions(transid, username, time, amount)
getAllCartItems: SELECT from cart WHERE username=?
removeAProduct: DELETE from cart WHERE userId AND prodId
getProductPrice: SELECT price from product WHERE prodid=?
sellNProduct: UPDATE product stock WHERE prodid=?
getFName: SELECT fname from users WHERE username=?
